title: Brouwer's Conjecture on Graph Laplacians
exact_target: Is the sum of any k largest graph Laplacian eigenvalues at most the number of edges plus $k(k+1)/2$?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1388 (GRAPH-001). CC BY 4.0.
Joshua N. Cooper, \emph{Constraints on Brouwer's Laplacian Spectrum Conjecture} (2020), arXiv:2003.03447v1, Section 1, equation (1), pp. 1--2.
